patthana23.53:1.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ namicchattaniyataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho micchattaniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.53:2.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nasammattaniyataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho sammattaniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.53:3.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naaniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho aniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā ekavīsa.
